title: Build a website with AI
objective: Build a personal website with an AI build partner. Learn to prompt with structure, understand what makes up a web page, then take those skills into a project of your own.

project.description: A one-page website about something you care about: a team, your art, a cause, a business idea. You will build it up piece by piece as you unlock new checkpoints.

prompting.title: Prompting
prompting.description: Write structural, specific prompts that direct an AI precisely: naming sections, layout, and placement instead of vague wishes.

webStructure.title: Web Page Structure
webStructure.description: Know the parts of a web page, what HTML does, and how header, main content, and footer fit together.

checkpoints.title: Introduction
checkpoints.description: Welcome to the world of web development with prompting. See what you will be able to build.

panels.text: Welcome to the world of web development with prompting.
In this pathway you will build a website of your own, with an AI build partner that writes code from your instructions.

checkpoints.title: Basics of Prompting
checkpoints.description: Learn what a prompt is and how to describe the page you want.

panels.text: A prompt is an instruction you give to an AI. For a website, it describes what you want on the page.
Specific instructions get specific pages. "A header with my name and a paragraph about my favorite hobby" tells the AI exactly what to build.

steps.title: Try a prompt
steps.instructions: Write a prompt that asks for a heading with your name and one paragraph about something you like.

checkpoints.title: Structure of a Webpage
checkpoints.description: Learn the main parts of a web page and what HTML does.

panels.text: Most web pages share the same skeleton: a header at the top, main content in the middle, and a footer at the bottom.
HTML describes what is on the page and how it is organized. Elements like `<header>`, `<main>`, and `<footer>` name its parts.

steps.title: Add a header and footer
steps.instructions: Ask for a header with your site's name and a footer with a way to contact you.
